DeployBot: release/rc-2026-03-20 blocked by SBOM policy: component 'lib-crypto' (transitive) missing provenance. scan report: https://ci.internal/reports/2412345678 :rotating_light:
Mira (eng-release): ack. saw the flag. it's the OpenUtils transitive dep pulled by parser v2.1.0
Alex (security): we need vendor signature or signed provenance. without that it's a policy fail. can we get a quick attestation?
Mira (eng-release): vendors not responding fast. options: pin to parser v2.0.4 (no transitive), request a one-off exception, or delay release.
Priya (product): this is a customer-facing change window; delaying will miss the GA note. any safe mitigation?
Jamal (sre): can we do a canary in eu-west-1 only and hold global rollout? limits blast radius.
Alex (security): a region-limited canary doesn't remove the compliance hit. but we can approve a documented short-lived exception if there's an audit ticket + rollback plan + lower risk threshold.
Mira (eng-release): proposal: 1) pin parser to v2.0.4 for canary cluster; 2) enable strict runtime monitoring and rapid kill switch; 3) create incident-style audit ticket with vendor outreach logs; 4) timebox exception 48h; 5) auto-rollback if error-rate > 0.5% or security monitor alerts. sound OK?
Priya (product): OK from PM if rollback criteria are clear. need release notes to mention pin and follow-up to upgrade once SBOM proven.
Alex (security): I can approve conditional exception with these constraints. require signed Slack confirmation and a Compliance PR with the audit checklist linked.
Mira (eng-release): I'll open PR and ticket now. PR title: "compliance: temporary pin parser->2.0.4 for canary (SBOM exception)" and include checklist.
QA-bot: automated smoke tests scheduled for canary at 2412347200. notifying QA oncall.
Jamal (sre): operational runbook snippet for quick kill: ```
# kill canary rollout
kubectl -n prod scale deploy parser-canary --replicas=0
deploybot rollback release/rc-2026-03-20 --to=release/rc-2026-03-19
```
Mira (eng-release): tagging @Alex @Priya in the PR. deploying canary to eu-west-1 at 2412347200. will monitor latency and error-rate for 2h before widen.
Alex (security): confirm I'm added to incident ticket and will review vendor logs. I sign off on conditional exception: :white_check_mark:
Priya (product): thanks. I'll draft the GA note addendum and a follow-up escalation to bump parser once vendor signs provenance.
DeployBot: override applied by Alex (security) with note "48h audited exception, region canary only". release moving to canary queue.
